decision: Approve shell-label and terminal-caret conventions scoped to the passive TerminalCard header and row responsibilities.

evidence.interpretation: Explicit approval of both named conventions offered in the owner questionnaire; not native review authority.

convention.name: shell
convention.meaning: Optional supplied shell-name label in terminal-card header chrome.
convention.whenToUse: A terminal-card header aligns a consumer-supplied shell name separately from its path content.
convention.avoid: Executing shells, interpreting commands, process state or built-in domain defaults.

convention.name: caret
convention.meaning: Whether a terminal display row renders a decorative cursor after its value.
convention.whenToUse: A passive terminal row needs a decorative cursor that is hidden from assistive technology and stops animating under reduced motion.
convention.avoid: Editable text selection, keyboard focus, input caret positioning or meaningful status communicated only through animation.
